name: Acquire
description: Acquire is a customer-engagement platform for live chat, messaging, video, voice, co-browsing, chatbots, cases, contacts, knowledge, analytics, and support operations.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Acquire account ID and dedicated API key, then let selected agents use content-free case operations or approved documented API v1 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: ACQUIRE_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Acquire account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the workspace hostname label before .acquire.io.

credentialRequirements.name: ACQUIRE_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Acquire API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated revocable API key with custom least-privilege permissions.

capabilities.label: Read case operations
capabilities.description: List and inspect bounded case operational metadata without titles, descriptions, contacts, users, messages, fields, tags, feedback, timeline, visit data, device data, metadata, or raw records.

capabilities.label: Acquire API v1
capabilities.description: Use documented account-bound API v1 paths and methods allowed by the key's custom permissions.

approvalRequired.label: List case metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded first response of content-free Acquire case summaries.

approvalRequired.label: Read case metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Acquire case through Relay's content-free projection.

approvalRequired.label: Use Acquire API v1
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Acquire API v1 operation authorized by the configured API key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free case reads and every broader API operation require approval; account/version binding, Bearer-key isolation, custom-permission context, bounds, and provider limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; account/version binding, Bearer-key isolation, bounds, audits, custom permissions, and Acquire limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the account-bound Acquire API v1 origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the account-bound Acquire API v1 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Acquire account ID and dedicated custom-permission API key are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated revocable Acquire API key with case read and only explicitly needed broader permissions, enter the account/key in Relay, and verify bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader operations, permission changes, provider limits, rotation, revocation, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Acquire documents account-scoped HTTPS API origins, Bearer API-key authentication, selectable token permissions, one-time display, and key deletion/revocation.
Acquire's official getting-started guide defines account IDs as instance subdomains and full-access versus custom-permission keys across product areas.
Acquire documents Bearer-authenticated case listing at /api/v1/crm/objects/case with bounded response metadata and optional filters/relations.
Acquire documents exact Bearer-authenticated case retrieval at /api/v1/crm/objects/case/{caseId}.
